description: Election Commission - Parliament Election will be held on 05.08.2020 (Amending the Gaz. Ex. No. 2172/03)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the scheduling of a parliamentary election, amending the date for the 2020 Parliamentary Election to be held on 05th August, 2020. It is a notice issued under Section 24(3) of the Parliamentary Elections Act by the Election Commission, making it a clear example of an electoral process announcement that falls under the Elections category.
